content.text: Enter Bolingbroke as King, Harry Percy and other Lords.

lines.text: Can no man tell me of my unthrifty son?
lines.plainText: Can no man tell me of my unthrifty son

lines.plainText: 'Tis full three months since I did see him last

lines.plainText: If any plague hang over us 'tis he

lines.plainText: For there they say he daily doth frequent

lines.plainText: What means our cousin that he stares and looks so wildly

lines.plainText: To have some conference with your Grace alone

lines.plainText: Withdraw yourselves and leave us here alone

lines.plainText: Thou hast a traitor in thy presence there

lines.plainText: Drawing Villain I'll make thee safe

lines.plainText: Stay thy revengeful hand Thou hast no cause to fear

content.text: [King Henry unlocks the door; and afterwards, relocks it.]

lines.text: What is the matter, uncle? Speak!
lines.plainText: What is the matter uncle Speak

lines.text: Recover breath. Tell us how near is danger,
lines.plainText: Recover breath Tell us how near is danger

lines.text: That we may arm us to encounter it.
lines.plainText: That we may arm us to encounter it

lines.plainText: Peruse this writing here and thou shalt know

lines.text: The treason that my haste forbids me show.
lines.plainText: The treason that my haste forbids me show

lines.plainText: Remember as thou read'st thy promise passed

lines.plainText: I do repent me Read not my name there

lines.plainText: My heart is not confederate with my hand

lines.plainText: It was villain ere thy hand did set it down

lines.plainText: I tore it from the traitor's bosom king

lines.plainText: Fear and not love begets his penitence

lines.plainText: Forget to pity him lest thy pity prove

lines.plainText: A serpent that will sting thee to the heart

lines.plainText: O loyal father of a treacherous son

lines.plainText: Thou sheer immaculate and silver fountain

lines.plainText: From whence this stream through muddy passages

lines.plainText: Hath held his current and defiled himself

lines.text: Thy overflow of good converts to bad,
lines.plainText: Thy overflow of good converts to bad

lines.plainText: And thy abundant goodness shall excuse

lines.plainText: This deadly blot in thy digressing son

lines.plainText: And he shall spend mine honour with his shame

lines.plainText: As thriftless sons their scraping fathers' gold

lines.plainText: Or my shamed life in his dishonour lies

lines.plainText: What shrillvoiced suppliant makes this eager cry

lines.plainText: Within A woman and thine aunt great king 'tis I

lines.text: Speak with me, pity me, open the door!
lines.plainText: Speak with me pity me open the door

lines.text: A beggar begs that never begged before.
lines.plainText: A beggar begs that never begged before

lines.text: Our scene is altered from a serious thing,
lines.plainText: Our scene is altered from a serious thing

lines.text: And now changed to "The Beggar and the King."
lines.plainText: And now changed to The Beggar and the King

lines.text: My dangerous cousin, let your mother in.
lines.plainText: My dangerous cousin let your mother in

lines.text: I know she's come to pray for your foul sin.
lines.plainText: I know she's come to pray for your foul sin

lines.text: If thou do pardon whosoever pray,
lines.plainText: If thou do pardon whosoever pray

lines.text: More sins for this forgiveness prosper may.
lines.plainText: More sins for this forgiveness prosper may

lines.text: This festered joint cut off, the rest rest sound;
lines.plainText: This festered joint cut off the rest rest sound

lines.text: This let alone will all the rest confound.
lines.plainText: This let alone will all the rest confound

lines.text: O King, believe not this hard-hearted man.
lines.plainText: O King believe not this hardhearted man

lines.text: Love loving not itself none other can.
lines.plainText: Love loving not itself none other can

lines.plainText: Thou frantic woman what dost thou make here

lines.plainText: Shall thy old dugs once more a traitor rear

lines.plainText: Sweet York be patient Kneels Hear me gentle liege

lines.text: Not yet, I thee beseech.
lines.plainText: Not yet I thee beseech

lines.plainText: For ever will I walk upon my knees

lines.plainText: And never see day that the happy sees

lines.plainText: Till thou give joy until thou bid me joy

lines.plainText: By pardoning Rutland my transgressing boy

lines.plainText: Unto my mother's prayers I bend my knee

lines.plainText: Against them both my true joints bended be

lines.plainText: He prays but faintly and would be denied

lines.plainText: We pray with heart and soul and all beside

lines.plainText: His weary joints would gladly rise I know

lines.plainText: Our knees still kneel till to the ground they grow

lines.plainText: His prayers are full of false hypocrisy

lines.plainText: That mercy which true prayer ought to have

lines.plainText: Pardon should be the first word of thy speech

lines.plainText: I never longed to hear a word till now

lines.plainText: Dost thou teach pardon pardon to destroy

lines.plainText: That sets the word itself against the word

lines.plainText: Pardon is all the suit I have in hand

lines.plainText: I pardon him as God shall pardon me

lines.plainText: But makes one pardon strong

lines.plainText: I pardon him

lines.plainText: But I will have them if I once know where
